expected_steps.name: Insert dowels into side frame rails
expected_steps.description: Insert 6 wooden dowels (128832) into the pre-drilled holes on the two long slatted side-frame rails, seating them into both side leg-and-slat sub-assemblies to prepare the wood-to-wood joints.
visual_cues: Operator holding small ribbed cylindrical wooden dowels
Pressing dowels by hand into end-grain/face holes on two flat slatted rail assemblies lying face down
Two identical rectangular slatted panels, each with exposed dowel pins protruding from the joint edges
Close-up inset showing dowels seated flush into round holes
expected_steps.completion_state: Wooden dowels stick out of the slatted side rails or join them to the leg assemblies.

expected_steps.name: Attach bottom slat rail and raise first side
expected_steps.description: Fit the long bottom slatted stretcher rail onto the dowels of one side leg assembly, then rotate that side upward from flat on the floor to a vertical standing position.
visual_cues: Operator kneeling and pushing a long horizontal slatted rail into the dowel joints of an upright leg frame
Curved arrow indicating the leg-and-slat panel rotating upward off the floor
A second, smaller slatted end panel lying flat and unattached in the foreground
Close-up inset of a dowel aligning into a corner post hole
expected_steps.completion_state: At least one leg assembly stands vertically, joined to a long slatted bottom rail.

expected_steps.name: Raise second side to close the frame
expected_steps.description: Rotate the second side leg assembly upward into place at the opposite end of the bottom slatted rail, closing the structure into a full open rectangular box frame.
visual_cues: The bench frame now shown as a complete open box with slatted bottom and four vertical corner posts
Curved arrow showing the remaining leg panel swinging upright into its final position
Close-up inset of the finished corner joint with dowel and gap visible before fastening
No visible fasteners yet — posts held only by dowel friction fit
expected_steps.completion_state: Leg assemblies stand vertically at both ends, forming a closed rectangular frame.

expected_steps.name: Fasten corner posts with cross dowels and long bolts
expected_steps.description: Insert 4 cross dowels/barrel nuts (117853) into the side holes of the four corner posts and secure each corner joint with a long domed-head bolt (113152), tightened using the Allen key (100001). The similar-looking pointed dowel screw (106581) is explicitly not used here.
visual_cues: Inset showing two similar fasteners side by side with one crossed out, distinguishing bolt 113152 from dowel screw 106581
Operator inserting a slotted cylindrical cross dowel into a small round side hole near a corner post
Long silver bolt with a flat domed head being threaded horizontally through the post into the cross dowel
L-shaped silver Allen key engaged in the bolt head with a rotational tightening motion at each of the four top corners
expected_steps.completion_state: Bolt heads are visible on all four corner posts of the frame.

expected_steps.name: Fasten center stretcher with cross dowels and dowel screws
expected_steps.description: Insert 2 cross dowels (113153) into the center support beam and secure the middle stretcher to the frame using 2 pointed dowel screws (106581), driven and tightened with the Allen key (100001).
visual_cues: Close-up inset of a slotted cross dowel being pressed into a round hole on the underside of the center rail
Pointed, coarse-threaded dowel screw with a flat domed head being driven into the cross dowel from outside the frame
L-shaped Allen key engaged with the screw head, shown with a curved motion line indicating turning
View from beneath the bench frame showing the diagonal center support beam
expected_steps.completion_state: A middle stretcher beam is attached across the center of the frame.

expected_steps.name: Screw seat-slat support ledgers to corner posts
expected_steps.description: Drive 4 Phillips-head wood screws (10046802) through the inner face of the corner posts to fix the seat-slat support ledgers in place, using a cross-head screwdriver.
visual_cues: Close-up inset of a Phillips/cross-head wood screw with a curved arrow showing rotational driving motion
Screws being driven horizontally into the inner faces of the four corner posts just below the top edge
Completed slatted bench frame shown fully upright with all four corners now fastened
No Allen key visible in this step — only a cross-head screwdriver icon
expected_steps.completion_state: Support ledgers are screwed to the inner faces of the corner posts.
